description: Windows optimizer with reversible, documented tweaks, game profiles, startup management, and before/after benchmarks.
notes: Uses the official portable ZIP; Scoop extracts Framecalm.exe, Framecalm.ElevatedHelper.exe, and PresentMon.exe into the version directory without running the Inno Setup installer.
Framecalm stores its own settings, history, captures, and backups in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Framecalm, outside the Scoop application directory. These files are not removed by Scoop uninstall.
Applying tweaks changes Windows settings by design. Review each tweak and its tier in the application before applying it; installing or launching this manifest does not apply tweaks.
